jobs.description:
Job Description

Location

We are looking for candidates who are willing to locate to a variety of locations based in Peterborough and surrounding area, where they can develop and extend their skills and capabilities in this exciting discipline. This would be for September 2027 intake.

Project Overview

The Anglian Water Strategic Pipeline Alliance (SPA) project currently involves the planning, design and construction of circa 320km of new strategic, large diameter, clean water interconnector pipelines and associated infrastructure across Anglian Water’s region. The SPA Alliance is also taking on responsibility for the future interconnector pipelines, a further 260km of strategic interconnector pipelines and associated infrastructure.

At Costain, we help to improve people’s lives by creating connected, sustainable infrastructure that enables people and the planet to thrive. We work together to shape, create, and deliver pioneering solutions that transform the performance of the UK’s infrastructure ecosystem across energy, water, transportation and defence markets. Through our collaboration with customers, partners, communities, and wider industry we will deliver an infrastructure fit for a better future.

Full UK Driving Licence Is Essential

Please note that some roles may be within the Nuclear & Defence sector and candidates will need to obtain Security Clearance and have been resident in the UK for the last 5 years

Costain's Graduate Development Programme

The programme will focus on helping you to grow your personal and leadership skills, alongside business and of course, the technical skills you will learn day-to-day on the job, the programme will provide you with specific technical training for your specialised discipline.

The programme is delivered in a variety of formats throughout the 2 years and will allow you to establish a network of contacts that will help and support you through your first 2 years and beyond. We expect some of our graduates to rotate after a period of 8-12 months, to another project/sector of the business to fully understand the depth and breadth of the services offered by the company.

Our line managers are fully supportive of the Graduate Development Programme and will be involved in helping you along the way.

In addition to the programme, we offer mentoring and support in every area of work, as well as a structured training programme to enable graduates to work towards achieving Chartership.

Graduates may have the opportunity to work on a number of exciting and progressive projects around the UK during the 2-year period, in sectors including nuclear, highways, rail, water, airports and tunnels.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

Assist with collaboratively developing and maintaining robust detailed project plans for the Delivery Team in accordance with SPA and AW requirements.
Liaise with Delivery Teams to ensure consistency of key assumptions on methodology and outputs etc.
Learn what constitutes a robust plan that withstands detailed scrutiny.
Assist with ensuring project plans capture the full project scope.
Assist with ensuring the plan clearly identifies any delay to support claims for additional cost or time.
Assist with ensuring plans are resource loaded and the resource plan is maintained.
Assist with pro-actively ensuring project plans are up to date.
Assist with pro-actively identifying opportunities and risks in the plan and monitor the critical path and key milestones, advising the delivery team on any potential changes.
Assist with collaboratively exploring mitigation and what if scenarios to pro-actively improve project delivery.
Assist with developing 4D animations of the project plan to aid digital rehearsal of the project construction.
Gather and collate progress information and reasons for any deviations.
Learn to communicate the effects of progress on key dates and challenge team to deliver on time.
Attend site regularly to gather programme update information
Learn to communicate the critical path and key activities in team meetings.

Knowledge, Skills, And Experience

Site based engineering background
Experience in one or more of civils, water, wastewater or M&E
Knowledge of current HSE requirements
Computer literate
Ability to use planning software
Ability to interrogate / take information from drawings
Good communicator able to communicate detailed data to a non-data literate audience
Ability to work to tight deadlines
Ability to manage/prioritise workloads
Ability to adapt and challenge

Qualifications

Qualifications

Essential

Educated to degree level in a related subject such as Civils, Construction, Quantity Surveying, Programme Controls, or Project Management.
Minimum GCSEs (or equivalent) in Maths
Full, clean UK driving licence

Desirable

APM Project Fundamentals
Please note that if you are invited to interview, we will require you to produce your passport and/or right to work documentation.

As some of our project sites are based in remote locations, it is worth noting that you will be required to have the ability to travel to site.

About Us

Costain helps to improve people’s lives with integrated, leading edge, smart infrastructure solutions across the UK’s energy, water, transportation and defence markets. We help our clients improve their business performance by increasing capacity, improving customer service, safeguarding security, enhancing resilience, decarbonising and delivering increased efficiency. Our vision is to be the UK’s leading smart infrastructure solutions company. We will achieve this by focusing on blue chip clients whose major spending plans are underpinned by strategic national needs, regulatory commitments, legislation or essential performance requirements. We offer our clients leading edge solutions that are digitally optimised through the following five services which cover the whole lifecycle of their assets: future-shaping strategic consultancy; consultancy and advisory; digital technology solutions; asset optimisation and complex programme delivery. Our culture and values underpin everything we do.

Anglian Water has created a new delivery enterprise - the Strategic Pipeline Alliance. “SPA” is creating hundreds of kilometres of new, interconnecting pipelines to help combat the impact of climate change and keep fresh, clean water flowing across the Anglian Water region.

jobs.title: Communications or Policy AI Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
ABOUT MILLTOWN PARTNERS

Our clients operate at the frontiers of innovation - we advise technology companies driving change, global investors funding the future, the giants of sport and entertainment, and influential individuals on the communications and policy challenges that define their reputations. Our work spans corporate and financial communications, policy and public affairs to engage regulators and policymakers, policy communications and leadership communications. We underpin the full breadth of our capabilities with research-driven insights and campaigns. We're also pioneering AI-enhanced advisory work for both our clients and internal innovation, using technology to unlock insights from data at unprecedented scale and speed.

MILLTOWN PARTNERS AI STUDIO

Working with companies at the forefront of tech means that we understand the transformative impact AI is going to have on the world - and on our own business. We pride ourselves on the quality of our advice to clients, and we believe AI has the potential to significantly improve it. We also believe AI can unlock even greater potential in our people - freeing up time to spend in areas where it has the greatest impact, and giving people superpowers. But those things cannot be achieved just by using off-the-shelf chatbots. We are therefore building our own AI infrastructure that is designed around the work we do. Ultimately, what we are trying to achieve is to integrate AI into everything we do in a way that enables us to give better advice and allows our colleagues to achieve more.

The Milltown Partners’ AI Studio is responsible for delivering AI-powered innovation that elevates our advice and helps our colleagues achieve more. Our work encompasses both client-facing project delivery and the development of internal tools and capabilities. The team currently relies on a mix of generalists who split their time across AI Studio, communications, policy and research work, alongside a small number of dedicated specialists. Demand is growing quickly among clients, who increasingly want us to build bespoke AI-powered tools and workflows for them, alongside our traditional advisory work.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a communications or policy & AI solutions consultant to join AI Studio. You'll be embedded in client teams, working to deliver client-facing projects across comms, policy and research. This gives you the chance to own client work end to end: thinking creatively about what a client is trying to achieve and identifying the best route to get there. You’ll also be helping build new internal products that improve the quality and efficiency of the consulting team.

IS THIS YOU?

You may well think this isn’t you. But AI is still relatively new for everyone, and we’re not looking for a software engineer. We’re looking for someone with the enthusiasm to embrace new things, analytical rigour, and the aptitude to learn.

Your background will be in a comms, policy or research agency, and you will have vibe-coded tools that you (and possibly colleagues) use for work. You may not be programming-native, but you're technically capable in the broader sense - comfortable with tools, quick to learn, and confident building in ambiguous situations. You understand what clients are actually trying to do, you can empathise with non-technical stakeholders, and you can walk into a situation with no established system and make something good out of it.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Translate client needs into working solutions
. You'll get client stakeholders - often non-technical - to articulate what they actually want, and turn that into a workable AI Studio project plan.

Build without an established playbook
. You'll walk into situations with no existing system or process and build something good, drawing on tools-building experience from a sales, solutions architecture or agency background.

Own client relationships independently
. You'll lead AI Studio accounts end to end, primarily with technology sector clients, acting as the trusted point of contact for both technical delivery and client strategy.

Contribute to internal AI Studio products
. You'll help build and refine internal tools, such as our podcast and newsletter tools, bringing a client's-eye view to what makes them useful.

Flex across the wider practice
. You'll pick up communications, policy or research work flexibly, bringing the same client empathy and adaptability to those briefs.

Build a collaborative environment
. You'll give and receive feedback regularly, share what you know about client needs and solutions-building with colleagues, and contribute to an inclusive team culture.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Both essential and desirable requirements are guides rather than a checklist - if you meet most of the essentials and are excited by the role, we'd encourage you to apply.

Essential

Have vibe-coded your own AI tools.
Technically capable and quick to learn new tools, even if not programming-native.
Comfortable building in ambiguous situations, without an established system or process to work from.
A strong ability to empathise with non-technical stakeholders and translate their needs into a workable brief.
Experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) effectively and critically in a professional setting.
Collaborative instincts and a genuine commitment to contributing to an inclusive culture.

Desirable

Two to six years' experience in a comms, policy and/or research agency.
A strong understanding of reputation management, communications or public policy.
Experience using Github, VS Code, Supabase and n8n.
Experience working directly with technology sector clients.
Experience building tools for others’ use as well as your own.

WHY JOIN US

We're an independent, employee-owned firm, which means the people who work here share in our collective success. We operate across London, Brussels, San Francisco, New York and Washington, D.C., advising technology companies, global investors, iconic brands and influential individuals on the communications and policy challenges that define their reputations. Our culture is built on five values: brilliance, restlessness, comradeship, inclusivity and integrity. We expect a lot from each other, but we also invest in each other - through honest feedback, shared learning and genuine care that goes beyond the work itself.

Competitive pay with transparent salary bands, plus twice-yearly bonuses
Professional development opportunities guided by our career framework and progression pathways
Private healthcare and dedicated mental health support
26 days' holiday plus public holidays (outside of our annual Christmas break)
Hybrid working model, with three days a week in the London office (Monday, Tuesday and Thursday)

READY TO APPLY?

If this sounds like the right place to build your career, we'd love to hear from you. If the years of experience or salary band don't quite align with your expectations, please don't hesitate to get in touch - we're happy to talk it through.

Our clients operate at the frontiers of innovation - we advise technology companies driving change, global investors funding the future, the giants of sport and entertainment, and influential individuals on the communications and policy challenges that define their reputations. MILLTOWN PARTNERS AI STUDIO

Working with companies at the forefront of tech means that we understand the transformative impact AI is going to have on the world - and on our own business. We pride ourselves on the quality of our advice to clients, and we believe AI has the potential to significantly improve it. We also believe AI can unlock even greater potential in our people - freeing up time to spend in areas where it has the greatest impact, and giving people superpowers. But those things cannot be achieved just by using off-the-shelf chatbots. We are therefore building our own AI infrastructure that is designed around the work we do. Ultimately, what we are trying to achieve is to integrate AI into everything we do in a way that enables us to give better advice and allows our colleagues to achieve more.

The Milltown Partners’ AI Studio is responsible for delivering AI-powered innovation that elevates our advice and helps our colleagues achieve more. Our work encompasses both client-facing project delivery and the development of internal tools and capabilities. The team currently relies on a mix of generalists who split their time across AI Studio, communications, policy and research work, alongside a small number of dedicated specialists. Demand is growing quickly among clients, who increasingly want us to build bespoke AI-powered tools and workflows for them, alongside our traditional advisory work.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a communications or policy & AI solutions consultant to join AI Studio. You'll be embedded in client teams, working to deliver client-facing projects across comms, policy and research. This gives you the chance to own client work end to end: thinking creatively about what a client is trying to achieve and identifying the best route to get there. You’ll also be helping build new internal products that improve the quality and efficiency of the consulting team.

IS THIS YOU?

You may well think this isn’t you. But AI is still relatively new for everyone, and we’re not looking for a software engineer. We’re looking for someone with the enthusiasm to embrace new things, analytical rigour, and the aptitude to learn.

Your background will be in a comms, policy or research agency, and you will have vibe-coded tools that you (and possibly colleagues) use for work. You may not be programming-native, but you're technically capable in the broader sense - comfortable with tools, quick to learn, and confident building in ambiguous situations. You understand what clients are actually trying to do, you can empathise with non-technical stakeholders, and you can walk into a situation with no established system and make something good out of it.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Translate client needs into working solutions

Build without an established playbook

Own client relationships independently
. You'll lead AI Studio accounts end to end, primarily with technology sector clients, acting as the trusted point of contact for both technical delivery and client strategy.

Contribute to internal AI Studio products
. You'll help build and refine internal tools, such as our podcast and newsletter tools, bringing a client's-eye view to what makes them useful.

Flex across the wider practice
. You'll pick up communications, policy or research work flexibly, bringing the same client empathy and adaptability to those briefs.

Build a collaborative environment
. You'll give and receive feedback regularly, share what you know about client needs and solutions-building with colleagues, and contribute to an inclusive team culture.

Both essential and desirable requirements are guides rather than a checklist - if you meet most of the essentials and are excited by the role, we'd encourage you to apply.

Essential

Have vibe-coded your own AI tools.
Technically capable and quick to learn new tools, even if not programming-native.

A strong ability to empathise with non-technical stakeholders and translate their needs into a workable brief.
Experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) effectively and critically in a professional setting.
Collaborative instincts and a genuine commitment to contributing to an inclusive culture.

Experience using Github, VS Code, Supabase and n8n.

Experience building tools for others’ use as well as your own.

We're an independent, employee-owned firm, which means the people who work here share in our collective success.
